name: Chief Islander Mabel

intro.text: Chief Islander is a real job, you know. It means chairing the Council, settling disputes about walls, and being at the harbour whenever a ship comes. You'll take a seat, and I'll show you how we do things.

win: Well. The Council will be told you fought fair. And that you ate a lot of cake.
after: Tristan has a Chief Islander and an Island Council, an Administrator sent out from London, and a good many committees, all of them held in the same room.
